segments.narration: Four empires fell at once and nobody knows who won. The Hittites, Ugarit, Mycenaean Greece, gone inside about one generation.
Egypt survived and carved the story. Nine groups are named: Peleset, Sherden, Shekelesh, Denyen. Sea Peoples is a modern label.
Merneptah claimed six thousand killed and nine thousand taken in his fifth year. Pharaohs exaggerate, but they do not invent whole enemies.
Ramesses III fought them in years five, eight and twelve. His inscription lists lands already cut off: Hatti, Carchemish, Alashiya.
So here is the turn. Recent work reads them as refugees running from a collapse already happening, not the thing that caused it.
